newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end modestly up, Vale jumps.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end modestly up, Vale jumps.

text.p: Brazilian stocks absorbed early selling pressure to close modestly higher as investors snapped up top blue-chips late in the day, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most active shares rose 0.08 percent to close at 81,023 points. Market turnover was a moderate 415.1 million reais ($399 million).
The bolsa fell most of the session in an apparent correction in prices but rebounded at the close, bolstered by bellwether Telebras, which rose 0.16 percent to 92.30 reais.

But today's biggest winner among the top blue-chips was percent to 26 reais on expectations that Brazil's National Privatization Council this week will set a higher-than-expected privatization base price for the firm.
The company's common shares also posted gains, rising 1.08 percent. Vale's privatization is due to begin in April.

Power stocks also performed well on Tuesday, traders said. Sao Paulo power utility Cesp common stock surged 9.09 percent to 60 reais on good prospects for the firm in light of its upcoming privatization.
Cesp shares contributed to a rise of 0.44 percent in the Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index .IEE to 2,325 points. dropped 0.89 percent to close at 445 reais.
State oil company Petrobras preferred, which had been surging recently on optimism over the company ahead of a new oil law, lost 0.96 percent to 207 reais.
Investors said the market could keep rising on Wednesday but they noted volatility, particularly on Telebras preferred, could increase ahead of Feb 17 options expiry.
They said Telebras' closing price in the spot market could lead to the exercise of the firm's options at a strike price of 92 reais.
